```typescript title="TypeScript"

function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { preprocessing: { preset: PreprocessingPreset.Minimal } };
  const result = convert("<nav>Navigation</nav><p>Content</p><footer>Footer</footer>", options);
  console.log(result);
```
